sanskrit: tvaṁ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ | uta dviṣo martyasya ||
english: You, O Agni, guard us with your great powers from every hostile niggardness, and from the hatred of a mortal foe.

sanskrit: nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeya īśe hi vaḥ priyajāta | tvam id asi kṣapāvān ||
english: For no human wrath has power over you, O you who are dear by birth; you alone are the lord of the night.

sanskrit: sa no viśvebhir devebhir ūrjo napād bhadraśoce | rayiṁ dehi viśvavāram ||
english: So, O son of strength, O bright-flaming one, together with all the gods grant us wealth that is desirable in every way.

sanskrit: na tam agne arātayo martaṁ yuvanta rāyaḥ | yaṁ trāyase dāśvāṁsam ||
english: O Agni, no niggards, no lack of riches, shall ever injure that mortal whom you protect — the one who has offered worship.

sanskrit: yaṁ tvaṁ vipra medhasātāv agne hinoṣi dhanāya | sa tavotī goṣu gantā ||
english: He whom you, O inspired Agni, impel toward wealth in the contest of sacrifice — he, under your protection, shall go among the cattle.

sanskrit: tvaṁ rayim puruvīram agne dāśuṣe martāya | pra ṇo naya vasyo accha ||
english: You, O Agni, bestow upon the mortal worshipper wealth rich in heroes; lead us forward toward better fortune.

sanskrit: uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ | durādhye3 martāya ||
english: Protect us! Do not deliver us, O Jātavedas, to the malicious one, to the mortal who is hard to satisfy.

sanskrit: agne mākiṣ ṭe devasya rātim adevo yuyota | tvam īśiṣe vasūnām ||
english: O Agni, let no ungodly man cut off the bounty of the divine one; you are the ruler of riches.

sanskrit: sa no vasva upa māsy ūrjo napān māhinasya | sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
english: Fill us with wealth, O son of strength, O great one, O friend and lord of riches, for those who sing your praise.

sanskrit: acchā naḥ śīraśociṣaṁ giro yantu darśatam | acchā yajñāso namasā purūvasum purupraśastam ūtaye ||
english: Let our hymns go forth to him of the flame-bright radiance, to the glorious one; let our sacrifices with obeisance go to the much-wealthy, much-praised one for our aid.

sanskrit: agniṁ sūnuṁ sahaso jātavedasaṁ dānāya vāryāṇām | dvitā yo bhūd amṛto martyeṣv ā hotā mandratamo viśi ||
english: Agni, the son of strength, Jātavedas, giver of desirable gifts — he who has become immortal in twofold form among mortals, the gladdest Hotṛ in the settlement.

sanskrit: agniṁ vo devayajyayāgnim prayaty adhvare | agniṁ dhīṣu prathamam agnim arvaty agniṁ kṣaitrāya sādhase ||
english: Agni for you at the divine worship; Agni at the advancing sacrifice; Agni first in sacred thoughts; Agni for the swift one; Agni for the accomplishment of the fields.

sanskrit: agnir iṣāṁ sakhye dadātu na īśe yo vāryāṇām | agniṁ toke tanaye śaśvad īmahe vasuṁ santaṁ tanūpām ||
english: May Agni, who is lord of desirable things, grant us refreshments in his friendship; we ever beseech Agni for offspring and descendants — he who is the treasure-keeper of our persons.

sanskrit: agnim īḻiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam | agniṁ rāye purumīḻha śrutaṁ naro 'gniṁ sudītaye chardiḥ ||
english: Laud Agni of the flame-bright radiance with songs for our aid; men laud Agni for wealth — him who is much implored and far-famed; Agni for a splendid shelter.

sanskrit: agniṁ dveṣo yotavai no gṛṇīmasy agniṁ śaṁ yoś ca dātave | viśvāsu vikṣv aviteva havyo bhuvad vastur ṛṣūṇām ||
english: We praise Agni to ward off from us hatred; we praise Agni to bestow on us weal and health; may he be invocable as a protector in all the settlements, the dwelling-place of the seers.

sanskrit: haviṣ kṛṇudhvam ā gamad adhvaryur vanate punaḥ | vidvām̐ asya praśāsanam ||
english: Prepare the oblation; the Adhvaryu shall come; he who knows shall seek again the rule of this rite.

sanskrit: ni tigmam abhy a1ṁśuṁ sīdad dhotā manāv adhi | juṣāṇo asya sakhyam ||
english: The Hotṛ priest sits down upon the Manu's altar beside the keen soma-stalk, delighting in its companionship.

sanskrit: antar icchanti taṁ jane rudram paro manīṣayā | gṛbhṇanti jihvayā sasam ||
english: They seek him, Rudra, in the community by thought transcending; they seize the grain with the tongue.

sanskrit: jāmy atītape dhanuḥ vayodhā aruhad vanam | dṛṣadaṁ jihvayāvadhīt ||
english: The bird-bearer mounted the forest whose sister bow has burned across; he struck the stone with his tongue.

sanskrit: caran vatso ruśann iha nidātāraṁ na vindate | veti stotava ambyam ||
english: The calf wandering and shining here finds no one to bind him; he seeks the mother of those who praise.

sanskrit: uto nv asya yan mahad aśvāvad yojanam bṛhad | dāmā rathasya dadṛśe ||
english: And truly of his the great, horse-rich, vast yoking — the bond of the chariot has been seen.

sanskrit: duhanti saptaikām upa dvā pañca sṛjataḥ | tīrthe sindhor adhi svare ||
english: Seven milk one; two release five; at the ford of the river, in its sound.

sanskrit: ā daśabhir vivasvata indraḥ kośam acucyavīt | khedayā trivṛtā divaḥ ||
english: Indra shook the vessel with the ten descendants of Vivasvat by the threefold whip of heaven.

sanskrit: pari tridhātur adhvaraṁ jūrṇir eti navīyasī | madhvā hotāro añjate ||
english: Around the triple-seasoned sacrifice the ever-newer flame moves; the Hotṛ priests anoint with the sweet drink.

sanskrit: siñcanti namasāvatam uccācakram parijmānam | nīcīnabāram akṣitam ||
english: They pour oblation on him who accepts reverence, on the high-wheeled one moving all around, whose downward-hanging branches are inexhaustible.

sanskrit: abhyāram id adrayo niṣiktam puṣkare madhu | avatasya visarjane ||
english: The stones have poured out the honey into the lotus bowl, right at the overflow of the well.

sanskrit: gāva upāvatāvatam mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||
english: The cows have come down toward the great well of the sacrifice that raps sweetly; both its ears are of gold.

sanskrit: ā sute siñcata śriyaṁ rodasyor abhiśriyam | rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||
english: Pour upon the pressed soma the splendour, the glory of both worlds; may the flavor receive the bull.

sanskrit: te jānata svam okya1ṁ saṁ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ | mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ ||
english: They recognized their own home, like calves with their mothers; they touched one another with their kindred.

sanskrit: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṁ divi | indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ ||
english: Feeding at the jaws they make a foundation in the sky; homage to Indra and Agni — the heavenly light!

sanskrit: adhukṣat pipyuṣīm iṣam ūrjaṁ saptapadīm ariḥ | sūryasya sapta raśmibhiḥ ||
english: The stranger has milked the swelling refreshment, the vigor that goes in seven steps, with the seven rays of the sun.

sanskrit: somasya mitrāvaruṇoditā sūra ā dade | tad āturasya bheṣajam ||
english: The sun, urged on by Mitra and Varuṇa, has taken up the soma; that is the remedy for the sick.

sanskrit: uto nv asya yat padaṁ haryatasya nidhānyam | pari dyāṁ jihvayāatanat ||
english: And truly the track of the beloved one, his treasure-place — he spread it out around the sky with his tongue.

sanskrit: ud īrāthām ṛtāyate yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Rise up, O Aśvins, for the truthful one; harness your chariot, O Aśvins; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: nimiṣaś cij javīyasā rathenā yātam aśvinā | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Come, O Aśvins, with a chariot swifter than the twinkling of an eye; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: upa stṛṇītam atraye himena gharmam aśvinā | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Strew for Atri the hot vessel with cold, O Aśvins; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Where are you? Where have you gone? Where have you flown like hawks? May your help be nearby.

sanskrit: yad adya karhi karhi cic chuśrūyātam imaṁ havam | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: If today or at any time you would hear this call, may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭhaṁ yāmy āpyam | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, most invoked at sacrificial journeys, I seek the nearest kinship with you; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: avantam atraye gṛhaṁ kṛṇutaṁ yuvam aśvinā | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: You two, O Aśvins, make the house favorable for Atri; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: varethe agnim ātapo vadate valgv atraye | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: You two have warmed Agni with heat; speak beautifully to Atri; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: pra saptavadhrir āśasā dhārām agner aśāyata | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Saptavadhri with hope stretched out along the stream of Agni; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: ihā gataṁ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutam ma imaṁ havam | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Come hither, you two possessors of wealth and bulls; hear this call of mine; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: kim idaṁ vām purāṇavaj jarator iva śasyate | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Why is this recited to you as if an ancient thing, as if by an aged man? May your help be nearby.

sanskrit: samānaṁ vāṁ sajātyaṁ samāno bandhur aśvinā | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: You two, O Aśvins, share the same kinship; your bond is equal; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: yo vāṁ rajāṁsy aśvinā ratho viyāti rodasī | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Your chariot, O Aśvins, traverses the realms between the two worlds; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: ā no gavyebhir aśvyaiḥ sahasrair upa gacchatam | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Come to us with thousands of cattle and horses; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: mā no gavyebhir aśvyaiḥ sahasrebhir ati khyatam | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Do not pass over us with thousands of cattle and horses; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: aruṇapsur uṣā abhūd akar jyotir ṛtāvarī | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Rosy-hued Dawn has appeared; the guardian of sacred order has made the light; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: aśvinā su vicākaśad vṛkṣam paraśumām̐ iva | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, may it shine clearly upon you like an axe upon a tree; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: puraṁ na dhṛṣṇav ā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśā | anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
english: Like a fort, O bold one, burst it open — oppressed by the dark tribe; may your help be nearby.

sanskrit: viśo-viśo vo atithiṁ vājayantaḥ purupriyam | agniṁ vo duryaṁ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ ||
english: Desiring victory, with hymns of might, I laud for you Agni as the guest of every people, the much-beloved, the one at your homestead.

sanskrit: yaṁ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṁ na sarpirāsutim | praśaṁsanti praśastibhiḥ ||
english: Him whom the oblation-bearing peoples praise with eulogies, like a friend poured with ghee, like a pressing of the sacred drink.

sanskrit: panyāṁsaṁ jātavedasaṁ yo devatāty udyatā | havyāny airayad divi ||
english: Jātavedas the most praiseworthy, who with uplifted hand for the gods sent the oblations upward to the sky.

sanskrit: āganma vṛtrahantamaṁ jyeṣṭham agnim ānavam | yasya śrutarvā bṛhann ārkṣo anīka edhate ||
english: We have come to the most Vṛtra-slaying, the eldest Agni of the Ānavas, in whose army Śrutarvā, the great Ārkṣa, prospers.

sanskrit: amṛtaṁ jātavedasaṁ tiras tamāṁsi darśatam | ghṛtāhavanam īḍyam ||
english: Jātavedas the immortal, visible through the darkness, worthy of invocation when ghee is poured — him we laud.

sanskrit: sabādho yaṁ janā ime3 'gniṁ havyebhir īḻate | juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ ||
english: Whom these striving peoples worship with oblations, pouring libations with outstretched ladles — that Agni.

sanskrit: iyaṁ te navyasī matir agne adhāyy asmad ā | mandra sujāta sukrato 'mūra dasmātithe ||
english: This newest thought for you, O Agni, has been placed from us; O joyful one, nobly born, of good will, O wise and wondrous guest.

sanskrit: sā te agne śaṁtamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā | tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
english: May that prayer be for you, O Agni, most blissful, most pleasing, most dear; grow great by it, O well-praised one.

sanskrit: sā dyumnair dyumninī bṛhad upopa śravasi śravaḥ | dadhīta vṛtratūrye ||
english: That prayer, resplendent with glories, would lay glory upon glory in the slaying of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: aśvam id gāṁ rathaprāṁ tveṣam indraṁ na satpatim | yasya śravāṁsi tūrvatha panyam-panyaṁ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
english: A horse, a cow, one who fills the chariot, the fierce one like Indra the lord of heroes — whose glorious deeds you excel, and the peoples count wondrous and wondrous.

sanskrit: yaṁ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭhad agne aṅgiraḥ | sa pāvaka śrudhī havam ||
english: He whom Gopavana called most pleasing with his song, O Agni, O Aṅgiras — that purifier, hear his call.

sanskrit: yaṁ tvā janāsa īḻate sabādho vājasātaye | sa bodhi vṛtratūrye ||
english: He whom the striving peoples worship for the winning of the prize — be alert for the slaying of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: ahaṁ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti | śardhāṁsīva stukāvināṁ mṛkṣā śīrṣā caturṇām ||
english: I, invoking Śrutarvā the Ārkṣa who sends down the frenzy, touch the heads of the four who cut their hair like the troops of the shearers.

sanskrit: māṁ catvāra āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ | surathāso abhi prayo vakṣan vayo na tugriyam ||
english: May the four swift fleet ones, the runners of the most mighty one with good chariot, carry me toward refreshment as a bird toward Tugriya.

sanskrit: satyam it tvā mahenadi paruṣṇy ava dediśam | nem āpo aśvadātaraḥ śaviṣṭhād asti martyaḥ ||
english: Truly I have pointed you out by the great river Paruṣṇī; no mortal is mightier as a giver of horses than the most mighty one.

sanskrit: yukṣvā hi devahūtamām̐ aśvām̐ agne rathīr iva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||
english: Yoke now the most god-summoning horses, O Agni, like a charioteer; sit down as the ancient Hotṛ on the seat.

sanskrit: uta no deva devām̐ acchā voco viduṣṭaraḥ | śrad viśvā vāryā kṛdhi ||
english: And, O god more knowing, speak to us of the gods; make all desirable things real for us.

sanskrit: tvaṁ ha yad yaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūnav āhuta | ṛtāvā yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||
english: Truly when you, O youngest one, son of strength, were invoked, you became the guardian of sacred order, worthy of sacrifice.

sanskrit: ayam agniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinas patiḥ | mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām ||
english: This Agni is the lord of thousandfold, hundredfold prize; the wise head of riches.

sanskrit: taṁ nemim ṛbhavo yathā namasva sahūtibhiḥ | nedīyo yajñam aṅgiraḥ ||
english: Reverence him as the Ṛbhus revere the wheel-rim with joint invocations; O Aṅgiras, bring the sacrifice nearer.

sanskrit: tasmai nūnam abhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā | vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim ||
english: To him now, the heaven-aiming one, with your speech of Virūpa as your constant means, urge forward an excellent praise for the bull.

sanskrit: kam u ṣvid asya senayāgner apākacakṣasaḥ | paṇiṁ goṣu starāmahe ||
english: With whose help, with the army of this Agni of far-seeing vision, shall we overcome the Paṇi in the cattle-raid?

sanskrit: mā no devānāṁ viśaḥ prasnātīr ivosrāḥ | kṛśaṁ na hāsur aghnyāḥ ||
english: May the clans of the gods not abandon us like cattle bathed in the rain abandon a lean man.

sanskrit: mā naḥ samasya dūḍhya1ḥ paridveṣaso aṁhatiḥ | ūrmir na nāvam ā vadhīt ||
english: May the encircling hatred, the difficult hostile power of the whole, not smite us like a wave smites a boat.

sanskrit: namas te agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ | amair amitram ardaya ||
english: The peoples, O god, chant homage to you for your might, O Agni; with your weapons crush the enemy.

sanskrit: kuvit su no gaviṣṭaye 'gne saṁveṣiṣo rayim | urukṛd uru ṇas kṛdhi ||
english: May you not fail to press together for us wealth for the cow-quest, O Agni; you who make wide space, make wide space for us.

sanskrit: mā no asmin mahādhane parā varg bhārabhṛd yathā | saṁvargaṁ saṁ rayiṁ jaya ||
english: Do not turn away from us in this great prize-contest like one who bears a burden; win the prize all together, win the wealth.

sanskrit: anyam asmad bhiyā iyam agne siṣaktu ducchunā | vardhā no amavac chavaḥ ||
english: May this evil portent follow another person away from us in fear, O Agni; increase our might, our powerful strength.

sanskrit: yasyājuṣan namasvinaḥ śamīm adurmakhasya vā | taṁ ghed agnir vṛdhāvati ||
english: He whose Śamī tree the reverential ones, or that of the one of no evil sacrifice, has favored — Agni indeed increases him.

sanskrit: parasyā adhi saṁvato 'varām̐ abhy ā tara | yatrāham asmi tām̐ ava ||
english: From over the farther boundary, cross over toward the nearer ones; protect those among whom I am.

sanskrit: vidmā hi te purā vayam agne pitur yathāvasaḥ | adhā te sumnam īmahe ||
english: For we have known you of old, O Agni, as the protection of a father; so now we crave your favor.

sanskrit: imaṁ nu māyinaṁ huva indram īśānam ojasā | marutvantaṁ na vṛñjase ||
english: I now invoke this wily Indra who rules by might — him attended by the Maruts, whom one does not withhold.

sanskrit: ayam indro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinac chiraḥ | vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
english: This Indra, companion of the Maruts, split asunder the head of Vṛtra with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

sanskrit: vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtram airayat | sṛjan samudriyā apaḥ ||
english: Indra, waxing great as companion of the Maruts, shook Vṛtra apart, releasing the waters toward the sea.

sanskrit: ayaṁ ha yena vā idaṁ svar marutvatā jitam | indreṇa somapītaye ||
english: This is he by whom this sun was won, accompanied by the Maruts — by Indra — for drinking of the soma.

sanskrit: marutvantam ṛjīṣiṇam ojasvantaṁ virapśinam | indraṁ gīrbhir havāmahe ||
english: We invoke with songs Indra attended by the Maruts, the soma-possessing one, the mighty one, the widely extending one.

sanskrit: indram pratnena manmanā marutvantaṁ havāmahe | asya somasya pītaye ||
english: With ancient prayer we invoke Indra accompanied by the Maruts for the drinking of this soma.

sanskrit: marutvām̐ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṁ śatakrato | asmin yajñe puruṣṭuta ||
english: O Indra with your Maruts, O showerer of blessings, drink the soma, O hundredfold of will; you are much praised at this sacrifice.

sanskrit: tubhyed indra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ | hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ ||
english: For you, O Indra with the Maruts, the soma draughts are pressed, O stone-wielder; the singers of hymns call with heart's devotion.

sanskrit: pibed indra marutsakhā sutaṁ somaṁ diviṣṭiṣu | vajraṁ śiśāna ojasā ||
english: Drink, O Indra, companion of the Maruts, the pressed soma at the divine impulses, sharpening the thunderbolt with might.

sanskrit: uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ | somam indra camū sutam ||
english: Rising up with might, having drunk, O Indra, your two jaws quivered from the soma pressed in the bowls.

sanskrit: anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇam akṛpetām | indra yad dasyuhābhavaḥ ||
english: Both worlds lamented after you as you strode forward, O Indra, when you became the slayer of the Dasyus.

sanskrit: vācam aṣṭāpadīm ahaṁ navasraktim ṛtaspṛśam | indrāt pari tanvam mame ||
english: I have measured out the body of the speech of eight feet and nine-syllabled, touching sacred order, from Indra.

sanskrit: jajñāno nu śatakratur vi pṛcchad iti mātaram | ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
english: Being born, the hundredfold-willed one at once asked his mother: Who are the fierce ones? Who have been heard of?

sanskrit: ād īṁ śavasy abravīd aurṇavābham ahīśuvam | te putra santu niṣṭuraḥ ||
english: Then the power said to him: Aurṇavābha, the fearful one among serpents — let these be crushed, O son.

sanskrit: sam it tān vṛtrahākhidat khe arām̐ iva khedayā | pravṛddho dasyuhābhavat ||
english: The Vṛtra-slayer cut all those asunder in the cavity like wheel-spokes with the wedge; waxing mighty, he became the Dasyu-slayer.

sanskrit: ekayā pratidhāpibat sākaṁ sarāṁsi triṁśatam | indraḥ somasya kāṇukā ||
english: With a single countermeasure Indra drank simultaneously thirty lakes, to his very fill of the soma.

sanskrit: abhi gandharvam atṛṇad abudhneṣu rajaḥsv ā | indro brahmabhya id vṛhe ||
english: Indra crushed the Gandharva in the bottomless spaces and dusts, indeed for the benefit of the Brahmin seers.

sanskrit: nir āvidhyad giribhya ā dhārayat pakvam odanam | indro bundaṁ svātatam ||
english: Indra shot out from the mountains, held up the cooked rice-offering — the self-stretched bundle.

sanskrit: śatabradhna iṣus tava sahasraparṇa eka it | yam indra cakṛṣe yujam ||
english: The arrow with a hundred holes, with a thousand feathers — it is the one you, O Indra, made your ally.

sanskrit: tena stotṛbhya ā bhara nṛbhyo nāribhyo attave | sadyo jāta ṛbhuṣṭhira ||
english: With that bring to the singers, to men and women to eat, O you who stand firm among the Ṛbhus, born at once.

sanskrit: etā cyautnāni te kṛtā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā | hṛdā vīḍv adhārayaḥ ||
english: These mighty deeds of yours have been accomplished; the greatest of all with abundance — you held them firm with the heart.

sanskrit: viśvet tā viṣṇur ābharad urukramas tveṣitaḥ | śatam mahiṣān kṣīrapākam odanaṁ varāham indra emuṣam ||
english: All these did Viṣṇu bring, the far-striding one, urged on — a hundred buffaloes, the milk-cooked rice-dish, the boar that Indra had taken away.

sanskrit: tuvikṣaṁ te sukṛtaṁ sūmayaṁ dhanuḥ sādhur bundo hiraṇyayaḥ | ubhā te bāhū raṇyā susaṁskṛta ṛdūpe cid ṛdūvṛdhā ||
english: Your fierce and well-wrought, fine bow, your trusty golden bundle — both your arms, fit for battle, well-adorned, grow great even from the supple, the supple-increasing.

sanskrit: puroḻāśaṁ no andhasa indra sahasram ā bhara | śatā ca śūra gonām ||
english: O Indra, bring us a thousand puroḍāśa-cakes from the soma draught, and hundreds of cows, O hero.

sanskrit: ā no bhara vyañjanaṁ gām aśvam abhyañjanam | sacā manā hiraṇyayā ||
english: Bring us adornment, a cow, a horse as additional adornment, together with a golden mind.

sanskrit: uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā purūṇi dhṛṣṇav ā bhara | tvaṁ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso ||
english: And bring us many ear-ornaments, O bold one; for you are heard, O lord of wealth.

sanskrit: nakīṁ vṛdhīka indra te na suṣā na sudā uta | nānyas tvac chūra vāghataḥ ||
english: No sycophant, O Indra, is yours, nor a good listener, nor a good giver; and no other sacrificer is like you, O hero.

sanskrit: nakīm indro nikartave na śakraḥ pariśaktave | viśvaṁ śṛṇoti paśyati ||
english: Indra cannot be cut down, the mighty one cannot be overpowered; he hears and sees everything.

sanskrit: sa manyum martyānām adabdho ni cikīṣate | purā nidaś cikīṣate ||
english: He, undeceived, takes note of the passion of mortals; he takes note of the blame before it comes.

sanskrit: kratva it pūrṇam udaraṁ turasyāsti vidhataḥ | vṛtraghnaḥ somapāvnaḥ ||
english: Through his will alone the belly of the fleet one, the worshipper, is full — the Vṛtra-slayer, the soma-drinker.

sanskrit: tve vasūni saṁgatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā | sudātv aparihvṛtā ||
english: In you, O Soma, are gathered the riches and all the good fortunes, well given and not turned away.

sanskrit: tvām id yavayur mama kāmo gavyur hiraṇyayuḥ | tvām aśvayur eṣate ||
english: My desire that longs for barley, for cows, for gold — it is you it seeks; and the longing for horses seeks you.

sanskrit: taved indrāham āśasā haste dātraṁ canā dade | dinasya vā maghavan sambhṛtasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā ||
english: O Indra, of you I have taken in my hand the gift with hope; whether of the day or of the gathered wealth, fill us, O Maghavan, with barley of the Kāśī land.

sanskrit: ayaṁ kṛtnur agṛbhīto viśvajid udbhid it somaḥ | ṛṣir vipraḥ kāvyena ||
english: This Soma is the agent ungrasped, the all-conqueror, the one who breaks forth; a seer, an inspired one through his poetic power.

sanskrit: abhy ūrṇoti yan nagnam bhiṣakti viśvaṁ yat turam | prem andhaḥ khyan niḥ śroṇo bhūt ||
english: He clothes what is naked; he heals whatever is ailing; the blind man was made to see; the lame man was made to walk.

sanskrit: tvaṁ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo 'nyakṛtebhyaḥ | uru yantāsi varūtham ||
english: You, O Soma, are a wide-spreading shelter from those who cause bodily harm, from hostilities, from evils done by others.

sanskrit: tvaṁ cittī tava dakṣair diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣin | yāvīr aghasya cid dveṣaḥ ||
english: You are the discerner, O Soma-bearer; by your might from heaven and earth you ward off even the hatred of evil.

sanskrit: arthino yanti ced arthaṁ gacchān id daduṣo rātim | vavṛjyus tṛṣyataḥ kāmam ||
english: If those who seek an object go toward their object, may the gift of the one who has given reach them; may the desire of the thirsty be fulfilled.

sanskrit: vidad yat pūrvyaṁ naṣṭam ud īm ṛtāyum īrayat | prem āyus tārīd atīrṇam ||
english: Having found again what was lost of old, he set in motion the guardian of sacred order; he led life across what could not be crossed.

sanskrit: suśevo no mṛḻayākur adṛptakratur avātaḥ | bhavā naḥ soma śaṁ hṛde ||
english: The kindly one who shows mercy, of undaunted will, unhindered — be for us, O Soma, a joy to the heart.

sanskrit: mā naḥ soma saṁ vīvijo mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan | mā no hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ ||
english: O Soma, do not terrify us together; do not scatter fear abroad, O king; do not smite our heart with your fierce energy.

sanskrit: ava yat sve sadhasthe devānāṁ durmatīr īkṣe | rājann apa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvo apa sridhaḥ sedha ||
english: When in my own station I observe the ill-intentions of the gods — O king, drive away the foes; O showerer, drive away the slanderers.

sanskrit: nahy a1nyam baḻākaram marḍitāraṁ śatakrato | tvaṁ na indra mṛḻaya ||
english: For there is no other bestower of grace more mighty, O hundredfold-willed one; you, O Indra, show us mercy.

sanskrit: yo naḥ śaśvat purāvithāmṛdhro vājasātaye | sa tvaṁ na indra mṛḻaya ||
english: You who have always unfalteringly protected us for the winning of the prize — you, O Indra, show us mercy.

sanskrit: kim aṅga radhracodanaḥ sunvānasyāvited asi | kuvit sv indra ṇaḥ śakaḥ ||
english: What then? Are you the inspirer of the weak, who have stood by the soma-presser? Can you indeed be capable of helping us, O Indra?

sanskrit: indra pra ṇo ratham ava paścāc cit santam adrivaḥ | purastād enam me kṛdhi ||
english: O Indra, push our chariot forward even though it is behind, O stone-wielder; set it before me at the front.

sanskrit: hanto nu kim āsase prathamaṁ no rathaṁ kṛdhi | upamaṁ vājayuḥ śravaḥ ||
english: Come now, why do you sit idle? Make our chariot first; the fame that strives for the prize shall be the highest.

sanskrit: avā no vājayuṁ rathaṁ sukaraṁ te kim it pari | asmān su jigyuṣas kṛdhi ||
english: Help our chariot that strives for the prize; it is easy for you — what lies beyond it? Make us truly victorious.

sanskrit: indra dṛhyasva pūr asi bhadrā ta eti niṣkṛtam | iyaṁ dhīr ṛtviyāvatī ||
english: O Indra, be firm; you are our fort; auspicious comes to you the accomplished task; this thought is timely and potent.

sanskrit: mā sīm avadya ā bhāg urvī kāṣṭhā hitaṁ dhanam | apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ ||
english: May no reproach have a share in the vast goal, in the wealth laid up there; may the arm-spans be unobstructed.

sanskrit: turīyaṁ nāma yajñiyaṁ yadā karas tad uśmasi | ād it patir na ohase ||
english: The fourth sacrificial name — when you perform that, that is what we desire; and then the lord carries it forward like a friend.

sanskrit: avīvṛdhad vo amṛtā amandīd ekadyūr devā uta yāś ca devīḥ | tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuta praśastam prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
english: The immortals have made you great; the one-day giver has gladdened the gods and also the goddesses; make therefore a praiseworthy offering to him — may he come swiftly in the morning, rich in thought and wealth.
